issues.where: pit walls and curved rib ledges
issues.what: the pale, weathered, rust-and-moss-stained calcified rib arches and fractured stone slab are replaced by dark charcoal-brown blocky low-poly terraces falling into near-black darkness
issues.fix: rebuild the pit walls as pale ivory curved rib arches with organic weathering, rust-brown mineral streaks, damp green growth, and higher ambient bounce light inside the chasm

issues.where: upper-center and upper-right rim and sky
issues.what: a large, opaque, blurry bright-beige fog patch hangs across the top of the frame, blocking the far rim and horizon, while the lower-left pit lacks the rising wispy steam
issues.fix: remove the opaque upper fog blob and place layered, translucent, billowing steam rising naturally from the lower-left and deep interior of the pit

issues.where: foreground ground, chasm walls, and composition
issues.what: the close-up wet pebbled rim, fleshy plant root, and weathered bone are missing, replaced by a pulled-back view of smooth, blocky, flat-shaded grey-brown cliff ledges and a tall smooth mountain ridge on the right
issues.fix: move closer to a wet, pebbled, richly textured rocky rim with organic weathered stone and low misty distant ridges instead of faceted blocks and a tall bare mountain

issues.where: foreground crimson plant and background flora
issues.what: the wet, glossy, backlit crimson fronds with hanging water droplets are replaced by dry, opaque palm-like fronds shifted to the upper-left, plus two extra silhouetted bushes across the chasm on the right
issues.fix: render fine, wet, translucent crimson filaments catching golden backlight with dripping water beads, center the main cluster arcing right, and remove the extra palm-like silhouettes on the far bank

issues.what: the warm golden-hour backlighting, shimmering water reflections, deep chasm contrast, and soft wispy steam are replaced by flat desaturated beige fog with straight diagonal light streaks
issues.fix: restore low warm golden sun from the upper left, specular highlights on wet rock and distant water, deeper shadows in the pit, and turbulent rising vapour without rigid light beams

issues.where: overall light, colour, and depth of field
issues.what: the warm golden sunset backlighting, glowing water flats, and soft foreground bokeh are replaced by flat clinical lighting with harsh black shadows on the left rock and zero depth of field
issues.fix: add warm low-angle backlighting from the upper left, bright specular reflections across the distant flats, softer shadow fill, and natural shallow depth of field blurring the near foreground

issues.what: the tall, pale, long-necked stilt creature standing in the sunlit mist is completely absent
issues.fix: place the slender, pale, long-necked creature in the sunlit misty midground on the upper left, softly out of focus and rim-lit by the sun

issues.what: instead of several small dark-silhouetted creatures far out on the sunlit reflecting flats, a single large, stiff, unnaturally smooth pale grey creature stands right beside the rim in sharp focus
issues.fix: replace the close-up creature with several small, distant, backlit silhouettes standing further out on the glistening flats with reflections in the shallow water

issues.where: foreground-left crimson fronds and rock ledge
issues.what: the wet, dripping, soft-focus crimson tendrils over rough stone are replaced by a sharp, dry red palm-like shrub on a smooth, stretched-texture pale ledge with sharp polygonal edges
issues.fix: soften the foreground focus, give the fronds wet glistening filaments with hanging water droplets, and replace the smooth stretched ledge with rough, wet, weathered rock

issues.where: crimson frond edges and leaflets in both crop pairs
issues.what: at native resolution, the red foliage shows heavy speckled, dithered alpha-clipping noise around every leaflet instead of smooth, wet, translucent strands with golden specular highlights
issues.fix: replace the dithered alpha-tested foliage cards with smooth, finely detailed, glossy wet filaments with subsurface scattering and specular rim light

issues.where: dark pit ledge edges and crevices in the bottom-right crop
issues.what: thin, jagged bright-white polygon and UV-seam lines run along the dark smooth rock ledges and corners, and the rock lacks fine surface detail or dripping wetness
issues.fix: eliminate the bright mesh and UV seam artifacts, add high-resolution weathered stone and mineral-stain textures, and add fine wet streaks and water drips

issues.where: air in front of the left plant and chasm
issues.what: scattered short white vertical rain streaks float in the air instead of clear water droplets hanging from and dripping off the frond tips
issues.fix: remove the floating white rain dashes and attach glistening water droplets directly to the wet frond tips
